title: Recovery on an iterated pulled-back cover
statement: Let $q:Y\to X$, $p:Z\to Y$ and $b:Z\to X$ be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme] with $p;q=b$. Fix an open cover $U$ of $X$, modules $F,G$ on $X$ [def-pc-module-pullback], a morphism $\delta:b^*F\to b^*G$, and a family $r_0$ of morphisms $F|_{U_\alpha}\to G|_{U_\alpha}$. Assume localMapRecovery for $b,U,F,G,\delta,r_0$ [def-pc-local-map-recovery]. Let $c:b^*\cong q^*p^*$ be the canonical tensor comparison [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], and let $r_1$ be localMapPullbackFamily along $q$ with its outer two maps identities [def-pc-local-map-pullback-family]. Then localMapRecovery holds for $p,q^*U,q^*F,q^*G,c(F)^{-1};\delta;c(G),r_1$. No earlier base scheme or morphism to one is involved.

source.place: Tags 0095, 0096 and 0097, definition and adjunction of module pullback and composition; Tag 01ZR first proof for local recovery.

proof.text: Construct the comparison of the iterated and direct charts explicitly as pullbackRightPullbackFstIso followed by pullback.congrHom wpq; verify both projection equations by simp. For each module, form d₀ as the pullback of the direct restriction comparison, followed by the chart comparison v and the restriction of the tensor comparison c; form d₁ from the two successive restriction comparisons. The restriction-composition square identifies d₀ with l followed by d₁. Naturality of l identifies conjugation of the local morphism by d₁ with conjugation of its direct pullback by d₀. Pull the original recovery equation back along the constructed chart isomorphism, substitute it in this expression, apply naturality of v to delta, and cancel v.inv with v.hom. The resulting map is restriction of c.inv;delta;c.hom. Functoriality and identity cancellation identify the left side with the required pulled-back local family.

theorem localMapRecovery_composition
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (q : Y ⟶ X) (p : Z ⟶ Y) (b : Z ⟶ X)
    (wpq : p ≫ q = b) (U₀ : X.OpenCover.{u}) (F G : X.Modules)
    (δ : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback b).obj F ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback b).obj G)
    (r₀ : ∀ α, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U₀.f α)).obj F ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (U₀.f α)).obj G)
    (hr : localMapRecovery b U₀ F G δ r₀) :
    let c := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso p q b wpq
    localMapRecovery p (U₀.pullback₁ q)
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj F)
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj G)
      (c.inv.app F ≫ δ ≫ c.hom.app G)
      (localMapPullbackFamily q U₀ F G
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj F)
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback q).obj G) (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) r₀)
